description: A clean, modern commercial office space with an emphasis on texture and calm. The feature wall behind the workstation cluster is a full-height sculpted 3D panel in creamy white with an undulating wave relief pattern, creating an organic textural backdrop that also catches warm LED cove light spilling across it from a concealed strip above. The ceiling is a standard acoustic tile grid in white. The floor is polished concrete in a medium grey tone. The workstation is a back-to-back benching cluster for six — three on each side — with a light maple or birch worksurface, slim matte black metal frames, low grey fabric acoustic privacy dividers, and light oak pedestals. Black mesh-back ergonomic chairs surround each station. To the left, a full-height picture window looks out onto a green garden terrace with trees outside. Two bright linear bars of cool-white light run horizontally at a low suspension height across the table, illuminating the work surface crisply. A warm amber glow washes across the sculpted texture wall from a discreet cove above, adding a warm layer to contrast the cool task illumination. Camera at standing eye-level, three-quarter corner composition showing both the workstation and the feature wall, lens at normal character. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
